setting.help: Use Mock / POC for demo without API credentials. Use Google, DeepL, Azure, or LibreTranslate for real automatic translation.
Required only for Google, DeepL, Azure, or private LibreTranslate instances that need an API key.
Default source language for product content, for example en_US.
LibreTranslate /translate endpoint. Use https://translate.argosopentech.com/translate for quick testing or http://localhost:5000/translate for local Docker.
Comma or newline separated brand names, SKU labels, model names, ports, and technical words that should not be translated.
Automatically creates translation queue jobs whenever a new product is created. Cron/manual queue processing performs the real translation.
Automatically creates translation queue jobs when product name, sales description, or website description is updated.
When enabled, generated translations stay in Pending Review until a user approves and publishes them.
Automatically process pending translation queue jobs using Odoo scheduled action.
Maximum number of pending translation jobs processed per scheduled cron/manual dashboard run. Recommended POC value: 20.
Selected provider is tried first. Add only real fallback providers you want to use. Do not add mock in production.
Optional delay between queue jobs to avoid provider rate limits. Use 0 for no delay.
Base retry delay for failed jobs. Delay grows exponentially per attempt.
Reuse identical previous translations to reduce duplicate API calls and speed up queue processing.
Required only when Azure Translator is selected.
